page.layout: One printed page (right-hand page of the opening) with a main text block of running text in one column; a partial column of fragments of the facing left page at the far left edge (cut off, not transcribed as text beyond the visible margin letters). Running head at top centre "Lib.8." and top right "De decalogo". Page number 287 at top centre. Diagram-like brace structures inside the text block (Sunt autem, Prima rursus) are read as outlines.

main_text.p: abusu interdicto, omnes mediorum externorum abusus prohibentur: & e contra, tertium pietatis caput praecipitur. Mat.5.33.34.

p.i: Atque hactenus de legibus externa media cultus Dei respicientibus:

main_text.p: Quartum, est affirmatum, ita expressum. Recordare, &c. praecipit autem quartum & ultimum pietatis caput, quod ad homines proprie pertinet. Mandatum.4.

p.i: Atq; haec de primae tabulae mandatis:

main_text.p: Sunt autem Quae voluntatis assensum, & quae inde enascuntur, spectant. Quae creaturae puritatem, & impuritatem, spectant. Mat.5.28.29.Rom.7.7.Rom.13.9.Gal.5.14.
Prima rursus Specialia officia sanctitatis & iustitiae, ut quintum. Rom.13.7.8. Communia.
Quintum mandatum, est affirmatiuum, his verbis expressit. Honora, &c.
Quae communia praecipiunt sunt omnia negatiua: spectant Personam: ut sextum, Mat.5.21.22.27. autem Personae adiuncta. 28.Tit.3.2.
Sextum mandatum, his verbis exprimitur: Non occides: Synecd. omnia mala in personam prohibet: & officia sanctitatis in eam praecipit. Math.5.21. 22.23.Iam.4.2.

page.notes: Left-edge fragments of the facing page (letters such as "23", "12", "6", "bis", "na", "ef", "c", "is", "is", "fu") are cut-off remnants and not transcribed. Brace structures are given as running text; the verse-like references are kept as printed. The word "Quae" at the foot is a catchword-like start of the next page and is kept in the text. Some words in the brace outlines are uncertain due to scan quality.
